events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV burst onto our screens, changing music forever. Remember the very first video they played?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994, featuring anthems like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever.'

angles.name: Definitely Maybe
angles.copy: It's been 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival began – three days of peace, music, and a whole lot of mud. What a moment in history.

events.title: Elvis Presley Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled legacy of Elvis Presley, who left us far too soon. His music truly lives forever.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi
angles.copy: Today, we're thinking of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar pioneer who changed music forever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun.'

angles.name: Abbey Road
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' 'Abbey Road,' an album that continues to inspire. Which side is your favourite – the medley or the standalone tracks?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking it.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single on October 24, 1975, following its initial album release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates globally. A powerful message that transcends generations.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Launched 25 years ago, it put a thousand songs in your pocket and changed everything.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, commemorating the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his incredible cinematic legacy.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary singer-songwriter of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: The iconic 'White Album' by The Beatles was released on this day. So much incredible music across two discs. What's your standout track?
